title: Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.06543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent trajectories often contain both successful decisions and failed attempts, yet optimization with sparse trajectory-level rewards struggles to identify which critical decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. We observe that meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories can be distilled into natural-language process rubrics and used as process supervision signals. Based on this insight, we propose Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which leverages self-derived process rubrics for dense token-level supervision, thereby augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning. Specifically, the current policy independently generates multiple rubric bundles at each step according to the same group of trajectories, extracting candidate process rubrics from cross-trajectory behavioral differences. translated_title: 经验二次利用：用于特权式令牌级信用分配的动态过程评分准则
translated_abstract: 智能体轨迹通常同时包含成功的决策与失败的尝试，然而基于稀疏轨迹级奖励的优化难以识别哪些关键决策应当被强化或抑制。我们观察到，同策略轨迹之间有意义的行为差异可以被提炼为自然语言形式的过程评分准则，并作为过程监督信号使用。基于这一洞察，我们提出了在线评分准则自蒸馏，该方法利用自生成的过程评分准则提供密集的令牌级监督，从而增强以结果为中心的强化学习。具体而言，当前策略针对同一组轨迹，在每个步骤独立生成多个评分准则包，从跨轨迹的行为差异中提取候选过程评分准则。随后，一个冻结的验证器针对组内每条轨迹评估所有评分准则项，并基于捆绑…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出在线评分准则自蒸馏（ORSD）方法，从同策略轨迹的跨轨迹行为差异中自生成动态自然语言过程评分准则，实现密集的令牌级信用分配监督，以增强以结果为中心的强化学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which distills meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories into self-derived dynamic natural-language process rubrics for dense token-level credit assignment, augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning.
